name: Aeroporto Guglielmo Marconi di Bologna S.p.A.
summary: Aeroporto Guglielmo Marconi di Bologna S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manages, and maintains an airport in Italy and internationally. The company operates through Aviation, Non-Aviation, and Other segments. It manages and develops the airport infrastructure, including terminal, baggage sorting, car parking, traffic, and cargo storage, as well as aircraft runways and aprons.
